summary: First-round end-to-end testing of M DOT IT SOLUZIONE marketing site. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests pass covering health, inquiries (contact + quote + 422 validation), sell-equipment (create/list + 422), and newsletter (subscribe + idempotent upsert + 422). Frontend: homepage hero + WordReveal renders correctly, all 14 static routes render with no console errors, mega-menu hover works, contact and sell-equipment forms submit successfully with correct sonner toasts, products page shows 31 cards and Networking filter narrows to 8, 'Cisco' search narrows to 4, floating actions reveal after scroll and expose call/whatsapp/quote buttons, footer newsletter submit shows success toast. Zero console errors captured across the whole run.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend inquiry/sell POST endpoints return 200 (FastAPI default). Consider returning 201 Created for POST creates to match REST conventions — non-blocking.
No auth/rate-limiting on any public POST (/api/inquiries, /api/sell-equipment, /api/newsletter). Fine for MVP but should be added before production (captcha or rate-limit) to prevent spam.

Hero heading uses a non-breaking space (\xa0) between 'Built' and 'for' via WordReveal splitting on ' ' and rejoining with  . Renders correctly visually; only impacts exact-string matching in tests — not a bug.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed inquiries, sell records, and a random-email newsletter entry via API. Not cleaned up (no delete endpoints exist).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Frontend has clean data-testid coverage on all critical elements: hero-section, hero-heading, hero-cta-primary/secondary, nav-products (with nav-child-* on hover), contact-form/contact-name/email/message/submit, sell-form/sell-name/company/email/quantity/details/submit, products-catalog, filter-<category-lowercase>, product-search, product-card-<id>, fab-toggle/fab-call/fab-whatsapp/fab-quote, footer-newsletter-form/input/submit. FloatingActions only mounts fab-toggle after scrollY>400 (use page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(0,1200)') + 1200ms wait). Sonner toasts use text 'Grazie' (contact), 'Thanks' (sell), "You're on the list" (newsletter). No known bugs.
